answer: One defense is work-bonded identity issuance: like a nebula condensing only where real mass gathers, an identity forms only after the agent posts a work bond and completes peer-attested tasks. A raven-style relay network propagates each completed job's attestation, so trust accrues as a decaying graph score tied to real output rather than account creation. A beacon service publishes the graph so counterparties can verify an identity's history before paying it. Faking a thousand identities means posting a thousand bonds and doing a thousand jobs of work - the attack costs more than it earns.
